answer: Admission uses an escalating escrow: ocean activates an operator’s \(k\)-th identity only after \(k^{2}\) ember is locked for that identity’s lifetime. delta preserves the operator’s lifetime admission count across replacement wallets and hosts, so fresh keys cannot restart at one. Ten identities lock 385 ember altogether, with the tenth adding 100; simultaneous applications receive no discount. An unrelated newcomer’s debut still locks one ember.
